args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to
fail in the nightly build. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-half-even-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, despite the docstring already claiming ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switched `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.675 → 2.68`, `2.665 → 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed**.

Fixes the nightly build failure.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the failure**: `src/money.py` implemented `round_money` with `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring (and `tests/test_money.py`, per FIN-212) specified banker's rounding — `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. This broke `2.665 → 2.66` in the nightly build.
2. **Created branch** `fix/FIN-212-half-even-rounding` from main and committed the one-line fix, switching the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
3. **Ran CI** on the branch (run `ci-0001`) — it **passed**.
4. **Opened PR #101** against main requesting review from alex: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

The PR is now awaiting alex's review before it can be merged into the protected main branch.
